notes: Workshop takeaway: workload is bursty — long tails during market open (09:30–10:15 ET)
Baseline steady-state: ~120 QPS for short chat flows (avg ~60 tokens output). Customer wants baseline guarantees + headroom for 3x burst capacity.
Peak observed in simulation: 380–420 QPS for ~8–12 minutes during market bursts; planning should allow 450 QPS headroom for safety.
Tokens/day estimate from workshop: ~25M–35M tokens/day depending on personalization fan-out.
Customer quote: "We need predictable unit economics — no surprise throttles during market volatility."
SE notes: prefer model family that supports 8-bit quantization and KV caching; will evaluate 13B/34B variants first.
Security: must integrate with corporate SSO (SAML) and use customer-managed KMS for key rotation. Retention controls required for 7 years for audit traces.
SLA asks: 99.95% availability, p95 generation latency under 350ms for 256-token context, prioritized routing for latency-critical routes.
Decision factors: latency SLOs, committed throughput pricing, ability to burst across regions, and detailed audit logs.
Open question: acceptable fallback model on capacity exhaustion — customer prefers A/B fallback to smaller quantized variant rather than queueing.
peak_duration_estimate: 8-12 minutes typical market bursts; up to 1 hour during extreme events
steady_state_window: 09:00-17:00 ET with predictable micro-bursts at market open/close
throughput_guarantees_requested: Guaranteed steady-state 120 QPS with billing for reserved capacity and burst allowance up to 3x through negotiated burst credits
reserved_gpu_estimate: Initial recommendation: 6-8 x H100-class GPUs (model-dependent). Final sizing depends on chosen model variant (13B vs 34B) and quantization; include 20% capacity buffer.
routing_and_fallback: Prefer smart routing: latency-priority pool for critical paths, cost-priority pool for non-critical. Fallback policy: route to quantized smaller model before queueing; cross-region failover allowed.
sla_negotiation_points: Availability target 99.95%; credit-based penalties; SLOs tied to p95 latency measured at token level; on-call escalation path and RM planning; data residency for backups must be EU/NA region-specific.
cost_sensitivity_notes: High — finance requested committed discount tiers and clear overage billing. Wants 'unit cost per 1k tokens' estimates for each model variant.
operational_requirements: Telemetry: token-level cost breakdown per route, per-model latency histograms, per-customer audit trace retention. CI: model rollout canary for 1% traffic before full switch.
